data.name: Tikeshwar
data.long_meaning: Lord Tikeshwar is the god of wisdom and knowledge. He is also known as Tirreth or Tirrthankar. He is often depicted as a wise and contemplative figure, with a third eye symbolizing inner knowledge and insight.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge, wisdom, and inner truth. Encourages introspection and self-discovery. Helps one to overcome ignorance and confusion.
data.numerology_meaning: Expressive, artistic, and emotional. You are generous, caring, and self-expressive. You value beauty, harmony, and balance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tikeshwar holds significant cultural influence in Hinduism, especially in the various regions of India where Lord Tikeshwar is revered. In many temples and shrines, devotees offer prayers and seek blessings from Lord Tikeshwar for wisdom, knowledge, and understanding. Several literary and spiritual texts also make references to this deity, highlighting his importance in Hindu philosophy and tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: Lord Tikeshwar holds profound spiritual significance for Hindus, symbolizing the quest for inner wisdom, knowledge, and understanding. His third eye represents the awakened spiritual eye, which is said to provide insight into the deeper aspects of reality. By seeking the blessings of Lord Tikeshwar, devotees can embark on a spiritual journey towards self-realization and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Tikeshwar is a temple located in the village of Tikonpura, in the Jalgaon district of Maharashtra, India. It is a popular pilgrimage site for Hindus.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Tikeshwar remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Lakshmi Tikeshwar, a teacher in Kolkata, India, shares that their name Tikeshwar meaning "God of Wisdom" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Tikeshwar: God of the third eye, symbolizing inner wisdom and intuition. A name that evokes the power of self-realization and spiritual enlightenment.
